slug: 2026-03-04 Ethiopia's approach to use cases shows how to ground data governance in real-world priorities

facts.fact: DIAL says Ethiopia is navigating its first National Data Governance Strategy, which it calls forthcoming and still taking shape, with use-case work done in partnership with the government.

slug: 2025-09-18 Ethiopia's approach to their National Data Strategy offers lessons for Africa's digital future

facts.fact: DIAL says Ethiopia is developing its first national data governance strategy, begun under the Office of the Prime Minister with a technical committee from INSA, MiNT, the Ethiopian AI Institute and Addis Ababa University, which produced a draft framework that DIAL helped expand into a full draft strategy reviewed at a workshop.

DIAL's project page says it developed Ethiopia's first national data governance strategy in 2025 with the Office of the Prime Minister and lists a strategy launch and validation workshop among its 2026 plans, so the strategy was not yet launched; the page's own published date is 2024-02-12 but it describes 2025 work.

ENA reports the Council of Ministers evaluated the National Data Governance Draft Proclamation and unanimously referred the bill to the House of Peoples' Representatives; it is a draft law, not yet enacted.

note: Ethiopia is named only as the meeting venue.
The summary describes planned strategy content for Ethiopia and states nothing this study asks as delivered.
A January 2024 workshop weighed a data governance committee and data sharing directive; no national data policy, adopted or drafted, is stated.
The document describes a banking directive and a personal data law, not a national data policy.
